platform_contract.wsl_support_claim: integration inference; upstream README declares Linux but does not explicitly certify WSL

role_boundaries.agentswitchboard: workstation/bootstrap convergence, readiness, policy, validation, evidence, and escalation; not a second live crew orchestrator
role_boundaries.firstmate: canonical live crew runtime: decompose, dispatch, supervise, recover, and close crew work inside its supported runtime
role_boundaries.session_backend: terminal/session substrate only; it does not own project decomposition or AgentSwitchboard policy
role_boundaries.coding_agent: bounded worker that reasons, edits, tests, and reports inside its assigned branch or worktree

required_before_selection: live session start and detach/reattach evidence

physical_floor_recovery.authority_source: the exact NEXT_ACTION emitted after STATUS=BLOCKED_MISSING_TOOLS
physical_floor_recovery.continuation_rule: after bounded package repair, rerun the exact-head physical-floor entrypoint and continue until PASS or a non-package blocker is observed
physical_floor_recovery.p08_continuation_authority: Prompt/P08-class operators may repair allowlisted environmental prerequisites or invoke this continuation owner and resume; do not hard-stop solely on BLOCKED_MISSING_TOOLS

routing_disposition.reason: FM-BRIDGE-10 validates and crosses the Windows-to-WSL boundary only. FirstMate owns live crew dispatch and its native runtime configuration; the stale firstmate-crew-orchestration skill and route selector are intentionally not revived.

proof_ceiling: Repository and hosted Windows/Linux validation may prove the Windows-host bridge contract, exact upstream pin, explicit Ubuntu selection, bounded subprocess behavior, prerequisite gating, WSL-owned exact-head clone contract, and read-only interoperability floor. FM-WSL-12 may perform bounded allowlisted Ubuntu prerequisite package repair before rerunning the gate, but physical WSL execution, live FirstMate crew dispatch, worker supervision, project delivery, native-Windows FirstMate behavior, provider/model behavior, and Herdr remain separate runtime proof.
